candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E dey drink normally. E dey restless or irritable. E get sunken eyes. If you pinch e skin, e return normal. E never get blood for stool. Di pikin no dey cough or get any wahala to breathe. Di pikin never get ear problem. E never get fever. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E dey able to drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything.
